verdict.rationale: Gmail ships an in-product AI assistant (Gemini in Gmail), so letting users connect MCP servers is a plausible capability for it. However, the evidence pack has no mention of MCP client support or of connecting external tool servers. Google Workspace add-ons and the Gmail API are separate extension and developer mechanisms, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
